prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Approach and grab object, move and lift it, perform task, or scan the area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToLocation    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectHeavy    /> <Action ID = LiftObject    /> <SubTree ID = PerformTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />     <Action ID = MoveToObject    />     <Action ID = GrabObject    />     <SubTree ID = PerformTask    /> </Sequence> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObjects    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO MoveToLocation
			IF IsObjectHeavy? THEN
			DO LiftObject
	ELSE
		DO PerformTask
	END
